text: I really love coming here for date night! Food is always amazing and service is awesome! It seems like it's a family business so I appreciate that even more! Definitely try the pork dim sum and spicy tuna roll
This was the most amazing meal! It was so good we had to finish every bite. The service was spectacular. I highly recommend it.
The food is amazing! Best shrimp I've had in a long time and I eat seafood pretty frequently. Everything is so fresh and they definitely take safety precautions for COVID-19.

Got take-out wings and salad last night: definitely the best wings I've had so far in the city! We've been trying as many different places as we can (I lived in Buffalo for 4 years, so my wings standards are VERY high), and we will definitely be returning! They were quick and reasonably priced; can't wait to try the pizza and the rest of the menu!
Cilantro is a great new restaurant. They raise the bar on Mediterranean food that's well seasoned. Friendly owners and great decor.

When I crave a burrito bowl- this is where I want to go! You can add so many unique items and create your own very personalized options. I absolutely love going here! The portions are also massive so I always feel that I'm getting my money's worth and I get to head home with leftovers!
Can we just let this place die and make room for an actual Japanese restaurant? This is Japanese food the way Chef Boyardee is Italian food.

One of the better lo miens in town. Fried rice is pretty good too but hard to mess that up. Also got Gen Tsos chicken extra spicy and it was really good. Would give it five stars but the tso portions were pretty small for the price.

So sad to be writing this but I feel compelled. This used to be our favorite restaurant. We came once a week. The waitstaff was friendly and attentive. The food was delicious. However, for the past few years, it has been slowly declining. The waitstaff are careless and negligent, that is, unless you're with a big party. Then they ONLY care about your table. We waited over 25 minutes today (after we finished eating) for a box and the check while our waiter focused solely on his larger party. During the past like 2 years, they have never once remembered to bring me a side of sour cream that I asked for when placing my order. They now charge extra for chip and salsa refills. There are also fruit flies EVERYWHERE.  It's sad and I'm not sure what happened, but it's become a completely different place.
Great food will definitely order from them again Butter chicken was fantastic and everything was fresh and ready to go when they said it would be.

Glad to see that Costco has branched out its sampler department and made a restaurant. Just kidding, but that fish sampler is kind of small for the price though. I will, however, say that the mussels were tasty and a pretty good choice for happy hour.

This is probably one of my favorite places to go when we are meeting friends for a couple drinks or have dinner with friends. I enjoy the atmosphere that reminds me of a Roman dungeon (idk, I was drinking) and the specialty pizzas are YUM and the drinks....

Great spot. Pretty small seating area inside/hipster vibe. Counter seats available where you can see all the food being prepared. 

The potato Rangoon's were very tasty and is a good app for vegetarians . 
The coconut ramen was delicious! The broth was thicker then your usual ramen broth(miso). I added the shrimp which were fried and really small, probably not necessary next time. Will be back! It was a delicious meal!!
This place has the most underrated food in Tampa. Get the crispy Brussel sprouts and you won't be disappointed. The fried chicken is also to die for! Plus the staff is amazing

Great lunch at 3 Days in Paris! Delicious crepe made of spinach, egg, bell peppers and havarti! Cooked to perfection. Plenty of seating upstairs with a great view of the whole market. Must visit when in Indy at the Indianapolis City Market!

This used to be that Turkish lamp, rug, home decor store.  They closed the business a while ago and today I saw a beautiful Turkish coffee and sweets place opened up.  The owner lets you try any Turkish delights and they have dozens of different flavors.  I am sure in time they will have some signs explaining what's in all those beautiful Turkish delights, but for now just enjoy the samples.  We decide to get a box ($30), hazelnut, chocolate banana, honey, and berry flavors.  Quite expensive for what it is, but it is a unique treat that you can't get else where in Santa Barbara.  The baklava was also fresh and syrupy.  The turkish coffee wasn't made the traditional way in a copper pot.  I am guessing it is due to only 3 people working in the shop right now and they can't spare one person just stand next to the coffee and babysit it.

The food was good and different (I'm usually not a breakfast eater). I've never had potato waffle but it was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside  with a really yummy cheese sauce. But it was a little much for me to finish. It came with sausage, eggs and hash browns. 

That's not the reason for the 4/5... service was kind of slow even though there weren't many people at the time we went.

Yum! Ordered from here twice already during quarantine. The lamb gyros are wonderfully juicy and flavorful. The fries in the sandwich add a nice salty touch. Would recommend the tzatziki sauce on the gyro. However, the hummus and garlic dip were not the greatest - I would stick with the gyros.
Yummy place for sushi! The rolls were very nicely rolled and the sashimi was of good quality. Great price too.
Don't  eggspect to get your food fast. After the wait, I received the wrong item. Disappointed, since we waited for 45 minutes for the seat. However, the food was delicious.

New Year's Day 2021 dinner. We ended up at Cochon completely by chance because the place that we had intended to go for dinner was closed (why why why does Turkey and the Wolf do such a shitty job of posting/updating their hours?). We managed to snag the last available table, which happily for us was outside.

One of us got the black pearl drink, and while it was tasty, she did not appreciate seeing the word "plantation" used as an adjective to describe the pineapple rum. It's officially 2021 and your restaurant is in New Orleans: have some goddam respect and get rid of that stupid and offensive word. The cherry gose was good. For apps, we started with the fried alligator (because NOLA YOLO!) and the gumbo. The gator was way too chewy and "exotic" for one of us but the other one happily ate it. The gumbo was perfection: salty, smoky, rich, spicy. We couldn't get enough of it and it was probably our favorite dish of the night. For dinner we split the rabbit and dumplings, and we have to say that it was kind of lame. The rabbit got lost in the rich roux and the whole thing just ended up tasting like your average chicken-and dumplings dish--not bad, per se, but we expected better. Kiddo was happy with her side of mac-n-cheese. The strawberry mousse pie was also unimpressive since the crust was way too thick and hard towards the back and thereby impossible to eat, and the mousse was too airy so the whole thing didn't really work well as a unit.

Service was to the point but not p
Best ribs I've ever had in my life. At home now and can still taste them in my mouth. My wife and I are seriously contemplating getting in the car and going for Round 2. Seriously.
Best taco place in Indy. Cool atmosphere. Margaritas are killer! Easy in and easy out process.

Be careful and make sure you verify whether you went for lunch hour hot pot or for dinner hour! I went during Mon-FRi, 11am-3pm, and it was not a holiday. Therefore I should be charged the lunch hour price which is 17.95. They did not inform me anything when I was placing the order but they changed me the 24.95 dinner price. When I ask them why, the waiter just said "this is how it is now". I had to pay 14 dollar extra. I understand that this is a hard time for restaurants but I am willing to tip more instead of being charged extra for this.

Decided to check this out since it was rated pretty well. We did carryout and while we waited in the store for 15 minutes for 'fresh' fries, i guess they left our other food sit out b/c by the time we got home (4-5 minute drive) it was all cold, especially the fries! Food was just mediocre, the fried okra was the best tasting of everything. We got brisket, pulled chicken, fried pickles (super spicy!), sweet potato and regular fries and hog balls. All was meh.  But worse than the food was the fact that not a single employee was wearing a mask, including the people preparing the food that my husband could see from where he was standing.  Totally unacceptable at this time in our lives. Small businesses are begging for help these days...if they think so little of their customers to endanger their lives, how can they expect us to help them?  Aside from all of that, their sign that said, "why would I need to press #1 for English?," would have been enough for us to never return.
This Panera bread was literally 5 min down the street from where i live. I came for the chicken noodle in hopes that it would cure my cold.

Great hometown pizza joint. Been going here for years and will continue. Everything they serve is amazing. The Sunday pizza is to die for. Not only do they have great food they give back to the community which is a win in my book.

Great service and food. The service is on par and the food is great. I especially like the daal and chicken dishes (butter chicken and karahi)-- very delicious. It's probably the best tasting dishes and most authentic in Philly.
The food here is amazing. Staff here is very attentive and the atmosphere is quiet and chill. Parking is ample and highly recommend.

Went there this afternoon and chose to stick to what I always order and was disappointed with the non juicy dry spicy piri piri chicken sandwich..this was not how it was served a year ago.. the gulf shrimp hushpuppies were nice and so were the meat balls and veggie hummus but the main star Spicy piri piri was not at all upto the mark this visit!

This review is looong overdue...
I've been to Center Square Tavern (CST as I like to call it) several times now since they opened, and each time has been absolutely phenomenal! Food, cocktails, and especially the service are impeccable!
I've been here with my wife, friends (adults only), wife and daughter, and families...and CST is perfect for each one of these groups. While family friendly, it's also a great spot to just grab a drink (or several)! This place has private dining, a nice sized bar, plenty of seating, live music on certain nights, and an outdoor patio area.
The wait staff is here is very nice and super attentive. Every dining experience has been great, but two that stick out are Kelly (my daughter absolutely LOVES her), and Madison (this gal ran across the entire parking lot after us because we left something behind).
The bartenders here are awesome. Elizabeth always has some new spicy drink for my wife to try, Joey G is a man that can pour, and Kelly ensures your glass is never empty.
The food here is incredible! CST has officially been crowned the Best Wings in South Jersey (by me)! Seriously. Too Hot is my absolute favorite--while it's definitely quite spicy, it is not overbearing and has an excellent flavor. The Executive Chef Dan Luber came out to meet us and see the "daring couple" that ordered them. All the dishes I've had here have been awesome--kudos to Dan for a job well done! Also, you'll see Dan roaming around the dining room speaking to the diners a

Wow is all I can say. From the decor, service, ambiance and cuisine it was perfection. I'm a total meat lover- ribs are my fav- this place was completely satisfying as far as flavor, texture and filling go. We did not have room for dessert. It took us a long time to try because my husband was worried he'd still be Hungry after.... not the case. We recommend the crab cakes, tacos, burger and the seasonal salad of heirloom tomatoes and avocado. Yum!!

Every seat in the house was beautiful and the cocktails were fresh and fantastic. The service was friendly and prompt. 

I was truly blown away with this place. A MUST GO!!

I went here often for lunch as our office is near by. It was a nice treat, all the food I've tried was good.  I personally recommend the alambre.  It is saute steak with peppers, onions, and bacon.  It comes with a side of rice and beans.  They also have a condiments bar, with your basic taco fixings.  Like cabbage, hotsauce, lime, onions, cilantro, etc.  

The service was always great when we came by.  They are all friendly, even though we'd have lunch right when the place opened up.

Went here with my mom for my 21st birthday last night it was the only place open till 1 am on a Thursday in Brandon so I took what I could get. The staff was very friendly. We were maybe 2 out of 20 people there and ended up being one of the last to leave I got ribs and they were ok a little dry but the fries were kinda gross. When midnight finally hit I got a mango pineapple mojito with sprite in it. This is my first alcohol review but I must say it was really sweet and after two my stomach was definitely upset.

Needs some improvements. First time visiting this restaurant. The ambiance is pretty ordinary, no big deal. The service upon entering was great! We were immediately greeted and seated.  There was no background music which was odd. You could here everyone's conversations which made it feel a little uneasy. The menu excited me the most. I love an "unordinary" menu! You can always have "cookie cutter" menu items anywhere. The drink menu was great as well. All though the bar  inventory did seem a little empty. We ordered the hamachi appetizer, it came to the table warm and fishy. I absolutely hate having to send any food back, unfortunately we had no choice. That was a huge let down. I absolutely love fresh sashimi dishes. This was not fresh at all. Then came the bulgogi lettuce wraps. I'm a huge Korean food fan so I was excited to try this dish. Unfortunately it didn't taste like bulgogi at all. Main course came, I had the wild boar dish which wasn't exciting like I had envisioned. The breading was not crispy and the gravy was very salty. The Ribeye steak and purple potato mash on the other hand was fantastic! The charred veggies was great. Everything on that dish was Seasoned perfectly. I'm excited to come back and try other menu items. Hopefully it will not disappoint.

Strolled by a line one morning and figured we would test it out the next day. 
Worth the wait - loved their lattes and the FIG BARS! Wow.  The chocolate chip muffin was moist and for a muffin... good.  Bought a loaf of sourdough bread to take home which was a wise decision. 

We went back again the next day..........

This was my first and will be last time here. Worst service ever (or shall I say, no service). My sisters and I waited for a table... when finally seated on the patio, we waited again. No drinks, no acknowledgement. Atmosphere is very stressful due to the people working there running around (law of attraction). I wished I had a video so everyone could see,hear, experience this visit. So yes, we got up and left. My review is on the service and not the food. It was on a Saturday during brunch time. For a restaurant that's been around, I expected better!
The food is really good. I especially love the biscuits and spicy gravy. I also enjoy having Mexican foods as appetizers. Win win!

Very good! This was the first place we came to eat on our trip to New Orleans! The staff were very nice and patient, despite us being pretty indesisive. The only reason I give it 4 stars is because the fried fish, made my stomach hurt. And I have eaten loads of fried foods, and none of the other fried seafood platters I had on our trip did that. It was delicious, but left me feeling nauseous. And their sweet tea was also a lot sweeter than I had expected. But otherwise everything pretty much tasted good, and made for a pretty great introduction to New Orleans food.

Cute little cafe right near the heart of Dunedin's shopping & dining district. Plenty of free parking nearby & easy to walk from here to other spots in the area too. 

I had a chocolate cupcake with cream cheese frosting and raspberry jam/jelly that was quite delicious! I also ordered a caramel java freeze, perfect for a hot day. In total, my order was just over $7, so about average pricing for things. 

They had indoor and outdoor seating, so I settled inside and did some writing while enjoying my little treat. While doing so, I overheard the employees engaging with other customers. They really made an effort to get to know their customers, including one of the employees named Omar who made several recommendations to a lady visiting from Minnesota, not just bakery recommendations but recommendations for the whole area. A great person to have at a place like this where tourists and locals alike wander in.

I love this new cafe in the heart of Soulard! They have a large drink menu and even some bites to snack on. The location is amazing. Perfect to get around all of Soulard. The decor is awesome. It has a library feel so its great for getting worked done. They have so many different books so chose from and they even have a "take one leave one" little table as well. They have a large array of mugs for when you get a drink and stay which is corky and cute. I highly recommend checking it out! The staff is super sweet & the atmosphere is so inviting! Happy to have them in my neighborhood.

For my birthday weekend I had the chance to try Chicago most famous deep dish pizza, in Indianapolis. 

Food: 

The deep dish pizza definitely had that gooey cheese stretch. The cheese definitely was oozing off the pizza with wavers bite. It was as close as it can get to the real deal deep dish fro Chicago. 

Staff: 

The staff was nice very busy due to it being a full house.

Environment:

The place was clean and up kept pretty well. 

Overall: 

Good place to go if you crave a nice deep dish pizza full of yummy cheese. Just not something I would crave every week.
Fairview Heights - terrible service, food takes too long, prices are too high for what you get.   Just a bad place to go.

I'm a big fan of this Mango Tree bistro. I came here before when I was house hunting in this area. We just wanted to stop by for some good Thai food, and I remember being pleasantly surprise about how good the food was. Four months later, we got the house we were looking at and we brought our family here to celebrate. We came here for lunch and they offer lunch special for a very reasonable price. We all were very happy with what we got. Everything we got here so far is delicious and reasonably priced. The customer service was alsreally good too, our waitress was very attentive and helpful. I would 100 percent come back here again.

Best key lime pie I have had in Florida!  The rest was very good too.  Lobster dog was interesting, blackened grouper is good, buffalo shrimp are very good.  Coleslaw is unique and good vinegar based with not overly sweet pineapple chunks

Stumbled upon this place while in Indy.  I had the stuffed French toast and a Bloody Mary.  The French roast was good, nothing to write home about.  The Bloody Mary was average at best.  This place does get packed and the waitress was nice.  I would come again when I am in town if I wanted something that had an easy going vibe and low wait time.

Steam Boys continues to add steam to Nashville's growing Asian food scene. My family and I came here for dinner and had a delicious spread of baos and dumplings. Though the restaurant itself is small, the warm ambience and friendly staff makes for a cozy dinner experience. They have since expanded their menu and I cannot wait to see how they grow.
Take 2 at sapphire lounge was amazing ! They interact with the crowd and really get you into it. Drinks and live music you can't get better than that !

I hadn't been to a Bahama Breeze in AGES, so when I saw one on SR56, I told the husbeastie we'd have to go. The opportunity presented itself when we were on the way home from our hamcation. 

We stopped in on the way home from Orlando and were in before it was 3pm, so we were in for happy hour pricing - half price appetizers, lower price cocktails.  We ordered the beef empanadas and the husbeast ordered their drink of the month, which we were told was one thing, but when it was delivered to the table, was a completely different drink.  We were fine with that, but would have liked to have been told 

The beef empanadas were absolutely delicious. I didn't need anything after that, I was done, I could have gone home happy right then, but I'd ordered more food, I'd gotten their fried chicken, and it was good, but those beef empanadas were so good, they over shadowed everything else. 

When we got our bill, we didn't have happy hour pricing, we didn't get the $5 price on the empanada. And our waitress was taking forever to check on us and get back when when had a question. So we just paid the bill and decided we wont be back.

UPDATE: The business owner reached out to me regarding this incident and stated that he does not condone this type of behavior. 
MY FRIEND AND I WERE REFUSED SERVICE. WE ARE TWO BLACK WOMEN AND A WHITE COUPLE WAS SERVICED IMMEDIATELY AFTER US. We believe we were refused service due to the color of our skin. The employee's name that refused us service was Nash Murphy. He told me that "the place was closed until tomorrow", then about five minutes after that, a white couple went up to the stand and received their Crêpes. After confronting Nash Murphy with this information and asking why he refused us service, he stated that "we had misheard" and that he actually told us the place would be open in 5 minutes.

absolutely the best african cuisine!!!!
my favorites are the red snapper and talapia platters. because of covid-19, they are only taking phone orders and pickups. 
i am never dissappointed.

This restaurant for me rates high for chain restaurant asian food.  I have been going to PF Chang since they came to our market and before my last visit I was concerned about where the quality was going. This past visit was outstanding. We sat at the bar and the bartender was great. Very informative and very knowledgeable about the menu.  I used to get szechuan scallops but they took it off the menu but the bartender told me about an item called Mongolian BBQ, great substitute.  I had a refreshing sangria which you don't think asian when you say sangria but I really enjoyed it.  We ordered the new Mongolian Beef appetizer but they were out they said it was too popular.  This visit I finished with New York Style Cheesecake and it fit the bill perfectly of a NY style Cheesecake.  Make sure if you're in the Keystone area stop and enjoy some great food.

Okay here we go the place was a complete dump HOWEVER after a night walking Bourbon Street a bit smashed its a good place to make a pit stop for a late night snack. Tip - Do not use the restroom either you'll have less chance of catching some type of infection squatting over a trash can on the street.

Barbuzzo is conveniently located at the center city in Philly area with plenty of parking near 13th street. It offers wide variety of  small tapas-like dishes. Moderately priced but not cheap. Each dish had a unique blend of flavors and the wide selection of draft beer and wine made for a lovely meal. 

We had beet salad which was really flavorful but I would have liked more and bigger sized cuts of beets and less greens.  Then we had the gnocchi which was absolutely perfection!  Best gnocchi I've ever had. We also ordered couple of pies for the table, classic marghertia and fungi, which included herbs, mushrooms and few different kinds of cheese. They were both very good. They served pizza with chili oil and a jar of "oregano" that looked suspiciously smokable :)

For desert we tried the Budino Jar which is a magical dessert with caramel, vanilla bean, sea salt, dark chocolate, cream and cookie crust. We also ordered their tiramisu.  It was kind of deconstructed and served in a cup.  It was really tasty I just wish it had more coffee flavor. 

The entrance to the restaurant could be better. As soon as you walk in, you are in the dining area. There is no lobby or seating for waiting customers. It's very crowded and noisy. Casual atmosphere with trendy decor. Despite this, the food and drinks were great. Overall, I'd definitely come back here! Wonderful first experience!
Such a great family owned spot for sushi, Thai curry is amazing. Employees are excellent. The unique music and disco ball are epic for ambience.

Good food with a cool, chic atmosphere... prices reflect great food, but you definitely pay for the ambiance. It's a go-to Santa Barbara dinner spot, but don't expect to be blow away by what's on the menu.
I love this spot! Best wings hands down!! And they do different slices of pizza every day, can't beat that!

I have honestly never been so disappointed with service. When we arrived we had to put our name on a list which is totally normal and fine, they took our phone number and said they'd call when a table is ready. We waited around the corner and saw 2 groups get seated before us who came after us, finally we walked up and asked where we were in line (even though we were told we were first when putting our name in) and they sat us.

When ordering the server kept saying that they didn't have things that were on the menu as if they weren't on the menu. For example my friend ordered a lemonade and the server was like ummmmm we don't have lemonade only strawberry lemonade (instead of saying they're out) this happened with about 5 items making me want to ask what they do have.

There were so many things forgotten, we had to ask for water twice, I asked for ice and more water twice that was never brought to me. I ordered a latte that I had to remind her of twice, it was finally brought about 10 min after the food. I even had to get up and get my own to-go boxes as they were never brought to us.

Lastly, and most importantly, I ordered a tofu teriyaki bowl and when it arrived it looked, and tasted SUPER bland but I attempted to eat it anyway as our server never came to check on us, when she finally came to bring the check I told her that I think that they forgot the teriyaki sauce on my bowl and she said "oh that's weird" and didn't offer anything. I asked for a side of teriyaki sauce a
Quality and portion size has suffered a lot.  Result of losing a founding owner or corona I don't know but was very disappointed.
Best brewery I've ever been to. Their food is perfect, especially their beer cheese sauce. I ordered the Mac n cheese and it is on POINT my friends. Been here twice and I already wish I lived here.

My fiance' and I had dinner at this location tonight and let me just say..the food and the service was outstanding! I got the boom boom bowl (which is my favorite) and my fiance got the tuna bowl. The food was delicious. Our sever was very polite and sweet even the manager Cody stopped by the table to ensure everything was tasting delicious. This is definitely one of our dinner go to spots. Please keep up the great service you guys always provide!

Word of the day is Cold! 
I have heard that this was a nice place but really since I've moved to East Nash I quickly learned that all the hype is just that so if it's raved about in east most of the time it's just okay. 
 So upon arriving we were told to find a seat. The server ignored us for a while even though there was only a few people in the tiny place. 
 He took our order then never returned to the table again. 
 The food took a while but came out ice cold. I had the Eggs Benedict and the hollandaise sauce was thin and runny while the potatoes were literally hard as rocks. 
  Like I said the server never returned to the table not even to bring us our order and no one bothered to ask if everything was satisfactory. 
 It was painful leaving that guy a tip even if it was a fraction of what I usually tip. 
Total waste of time and money.

Aside from the normally awesome dinners I've had, the now have brunch.  Seriously the Thai version on congee is amazing.   Add some chilli peppers in vinegar ( from the condiment tray ) is seriously an amazing twist on the typical breakfast congee...

Followed up with a Pad That Omelette, that was absolutely delicious.   Think Pad Thai, with an omelette wrapper.

This rating is based on the pizza only... Five very enthusiastic stars! Pizza is one of my absolute favorite foods and my husband is not a fan (I don't judge), so this means I don't have pizza super frequently. Most of the time I want hand tossed/NY style, which is hard to find in SoCo now that Ferraro's closed. But now I have officially found my go to spot! I had the Don Antonio and it was phenomenal. All of the toppings were perfect and the fresh mozzarella cheese was scrumptious (though I could have enjoyed a bit more). I will be back for sure! (Side note that did not affect my rating: The Buffalo hot wings were just fine, but the chef salad was disappointing and the house dressing seemed to be just oil. We will go there only for pizza in the future.)
We love Teng Da, usually have fresh sushi and their other dishes are very tasty as well. Every time we visit we feel as if we are eating at a friend's!

Great service. The nuts rocked. The vegan sausage pepper bowl was good and a nice touch of bread. TAsty. Maybe, pipe it down on the oil. Again, great, b it seemed slippery. I guess they are peppers. The crab cake slider was crazy good. Wow, a ton of chips too!  What happend here. No cheese in soup. No ask on do you want another drink. Hardly any tofu in my entree.

A co-worker and I came in just before closing after a long day of work and were very grateful to receive excellent customer service from both Wesley and Nicole. They took great care of us and got us on our way in no time. 4 big thumbs up from me and my colleague

Always our go to in our house. Not to far. The food is great. Big fan of their Pad Thai. Their vegetable tempura is incredible. But make sure you call them early because sometimes the run out. All in all 5 stars.

Free parking in the garage above the restaurant. Solid local chain with comfort food. Biscuits and gravy were excellent 

Several locations around town. Coffee was filled often. Only off thought was small coffee cups.

1st time visiting Freddy's.. and don't think we'll be back. The burgers, yes they are hand pressed, however, mine was so thin, and had old crispy edges.. looked like it had been sitting for hours. Way too much mustard and overly salty fries. The staff was super friendly, restaurant was fairly clean; however, food was a HUGE disappointment.

I don't eat here often but their food always hits the spot. Today, I decided to do curbside pick up and it was the EASIEST and most FLAWESS curbside ever with clearly and largely labeled spots. Ordered and then they text and you text back, etc. It was quick and timely and the food was hot & delicious. Seems they really adapted to the new age of doing things and I plan on going here more! WAY TO GO!

The lady ringing the register literally has no idea what she is doing and is slowing the progression of the food down. It took us 20 minutes to order our food because she was having such a hard time. She also isn't calling out people's food when it is ready, so it is just sitting on the counter.The poor girl cooking the food seemed to be running the whole restaurant by herself. Most def not impressed with the front staff, but admire the girl in the back doing the cooking. Food came out great, but need to get a better front check out person.

The quality of their pizza has not disappointed me in the 9 years I have been frequenting blind onion. The crust is delicious all on its own but of course it's a little more heavenly with honey to dip. The customer service is very friendly and welcoming. They do get pretty busy around lunch and dinner but hey that's a good thing. I like to grab a super slice (it's 2 big slices) and a beer and sit at the bar. My go to pizza spot!

Great butcher shop lots of variety organized clean offers condiments and other meal assortments
Meat is fresh and well packaged hamburger is very lean

We LOVE Sophia's!!

The best place around for Greek!  Family owned and Sophia knows me by my order EVERY time. 

Small restaurant with a handful  of tables a few on the outdoor patio as well. Authentic Greek food!!

Today we ordered a Greek Salad and added Gyro meat (no potato salad for me and light feta). She gets it right as always!!!  We also ordered 2 gyros with all the fixings. Delicious!!!!  We finished off the meal with 2 slices of baklava. Amazing!!!!!

Thank you Sophia for the best Greek I've ever had right around the corner from home.   We love being regulars.

8-7-2020
Wait time was an hour, but it's all worth it! 

Excellent customer service and food quality! 

My family ordered variety of sushi to try and different entrees. Chicken teriyaki was good too! 

We will definitely come back again.

A really tasty place to grab a burger. It can get crowded and they have several "family style" long tables, so plan accordingly if you don't want to sit by strangers or on a less comfortable stool type seat. However, the food is great. I think it's one of the better burgers in town. I have also tried the chicken sandwich and would highly recommend it as well. Fries are good. I tend to favor the regular or the truffle over the sweet potato. It is slightly pricier than the very casual spots ($11-15), but the atmosphere is much nicer than many of those same casual spots. Overall, Burger up is solid
Everything it's said to be and more. Everyone should have the pleasure of eating here at least once. Highly recommend the Sunday Dinner or going during Devour Indy.

As always, my go-to at Philly taquieras is a Cuban Torta. It is a filling and intense sandwich with a variety of stretchy cheese, beans, pickled vegetables, chorizo, ham, breaded steak, avocado, and eggs. It's very delicious and one of my favorite things to eat.

Taco Riendo's is good. The bread is light and airy, but lacks some structure that can make it hard to weird. I resorted to a knife and fork. The steak here isn't breaded, and I think it's actually pork. A fine addition, even if it's not what I'm used to.

I liked the sandwich and my partner liked her meal too. Between Que Chula and Taco Riendo, I'd say it's a toss-up if you're in the are.

Came here because we wanted to enjoy the live music out front! The drinks and oysters were good! The Bloody Mary was okay but lacked spice. We didn't order it but we heard that their oyster po boy is delicious! Would definitely have to come back and try it next time we visit!

Amazing food served in a pleasant atmosphere. You can find a variety of Persian dishes here, with the waiters introducing them patiently, and serving them in a timely manner regarding the courses. I especially loved their fresh bread that comes with starters. Main courses could be stews with rice, variety of mixed rices, or Iranian style kebabs, all of which are amazing in this restaurant. Thé staff are friendly and yet very professional. I definitely recommend Persian Room in Tucson.

We have a running list of new places to try in the City and this is one that we have been meaning to come to for awhile. My aunt was in town and wanted to meet for supper so we decided to try this out and are we ever happy we did.

First off all of our group likes trying foods from different countries. One of our group was also Celiac so I noted that in our reservation. When we arrived our table was waiting for us and the owner sat us down and brought up the Celiac notation right away. I can tell you I have made reservations to other places in the past and noted a Celiac guest and it was like it was never there. I was very glad she was so proactive about it.

Our host was so attentive to us and helped determine what items would be safe in conjunction with Chef. She made a modification to a dish to make it gluten free and safe. She also brought us out a free sample of the popcorn chicken (just for the non-celiacs in our group) and they were delicious. We also had a small bowl of kimchee. I had the dumplings in beef soup with tomatoes. We all shared what we could with each other so we got a good taste of a few menu items.  I was blown away by my dumpling soup.The popcorn chicken was awesome. I liked the Taiwanese kimchee. A bit sweeter than other kimchee I have had. My soup dish was huge so I only ate half and brought the other half home for lunch (which I just ate BTW). It was just as great the next day for lunch.

The food was so so so good! I can't wait to go back to try som

Miller's did a great job with handling Covid. Certainly know it can't be easy but very well spaced and servers were all masked. Very clean and precautions taken. David P was very nice and really made the first night out since Covid started really pleasant. The food is ok and good quality for this genre but service was the differentiator.

First visit to Salt Rock. Thoroughly enjoyed Rock the Boat; my wife raved about the fresh Grouper. Presentation top notch! From Delray Beach and only wish we had one there!  Personal as well as attentive service (waiter was Micah). 5 Stars easily!

The food is so yummy and fresh. If you're planning on getting a adult beverage, try the Tomatillo Mary. But the thing that made this brunch experience was our server. Zachary B. is an outstanding server. We had so many questions and he took the time to answer and make our visit perfect. Highly recommend for food/drinks and customer service.
So much hospitality and such a great vibe. Chill, spacious, easy going and bomb food/drinks. I just wanna sit here and talk with people for hours.

We decided to try Shelly's cafe for Saturday's Brunch. The Cafe was small and cozy cafe. It had a pleasant, soothing ambience. The staff was friendly and helped us to decide the order. We first started with drinks which included Orange Juice and Hot Coffee. For brunch we ordered Veggie Omelet, Tampa Omelet and Shelby's Pancakes.
Hot Coffee: The coffee was good and hot. 5/5
Orange Juice: We thought It was a tropical orange juice not fresh orange juice. This was only our complain. Rest everything was fine. 3/5
Tampa Omelet: Tampa omelet was healthy and fulfilling. Omelet was provided with english muffin and Potato chips. We loved the omelet. 5/5.
Veggie Omelet: Veggie omelet was also healthy and fulfilling. Both the omelets were amazing. It was served with potato chips and white bread. 5/5
Shelby's Pancake: We loved the pancakes it was amazing. 5/5
We loved this place. This was our first visit and definitely not the last.

Very authentic Thai food. The service was wonderful. It's a small-ish location but we were able to get in, no problem, and didn't feel cramped at all. The food came out quickly, they forgot one dish (black pepper beef) but they quickly made it and brought it out to us when we mentioned it to them. Everything tasted really good, I recommend the Pad See Ew especially.

What an interesting night- had reservations for 9:30p but previous group wouldn't vacate table so we ended up at the bar. Blessing in disguise!  The bartender who took fine care of us for drinks was even a better dinner waiter!

When we reviewed the menu prior, honestly, my girlfriend and I had to google a half a dozen ingredients because we had no idea. 

You really do need to take a leap of faith on any item because nothing is standard fare. It was the best 'surprise' eating experience I've had. The skate wing is indescribable so you have to get it. Wow!  And apps, salads and desserts were out of this world. 

A MUST- I can't wait to try something new next time. 

Well done Maypop!!

Christmas Dinner at Dell Frisco's in Nashville!

This wasn't our top pick for Christmas Dinner but it was one of the only places that had reservations left so we took it.  Upon arrival we were seated quickly.  But being that it was Christmas, they were WAY under staffed. We waited long periods in between to get service.  But since it was Christmas, it didn't bother us because we were thankful this place was open at all.

To start we ordered our usual cocktails.  I was in the mood for Sangria and my husband was in the mood for a Martini.  Both came out and were good.  

For an appetizer we ordered the Jumbo Lump Crab-cake *didn't come out until way later*.

For the entrees, I ordered their Christmas Prime Rib special and my husband ordered the Filet Duo.  These entries came out SUPER fast.  My husband said his filet's were good but they weren't hot.  We feel like maybe they were precooked and placed on a warming dish and as it was ordered, they were plated and brought out (probably due to being under staffed).  But once again, not going to complain since it was Christmas.  

Our appetizer never came out though, our waiter finally realized it and apologized.  He asked us if we still wanted it, to which we said yes.  Glad we kept it because it was REALLY good.  There were whole pieces of crab in it and you can taste the quality.  

The Truffle Mac & Cheese side was TOO DIE FOR! Truffle makes everything 100% better and this was no different.  It's a game changer.

Overall, $175 w

WOW!! So dissatisfied with the quality of the food and the service! Spoke to the "Manager" he was rude and really acted like he didn't care. There are SO many great places to eat. If your smart skip this place!! Over priced and not good!!

During all this Stay at home and Stay in, we have gone out for Pizza quite a few times.  There specials are great like a 2 topping large for $7.99.  You just can't be it.  We have chosen this Howie's for over 30 years now and all but one time they gave us a great pizza and the one bad experience they made up for.  Don, the owner is there quite a bit of the time and Howie's is our goto place when we want it fast and good.

so good we went two days in a row. service is fast, our server Kat was very good to us as well. Hosts are efficient and friendly. I personally recommend the Cacio e pepe pasta, it was delicious! We will definitely return next time we're in St. Pete.

Wanted to pop in and see what the place was all about. Boy am I glad I did! They had a large order that came in right before we walked in so we had to wait about 15 minutes but wasn't in a rush. Ordered the cheesesteak and the Italian, both phenomenal. In laws got a sub turned into a salad for their Keto diet and they enjoyed as well. All in all a nine out of 10 for a great new sandwich shop!

4 of us at the bar for Sat night dinner. Owner very gracious and welcoming. Margaritas and a nice, full-pour pint.  Mole enchilada plate very generous,  carnitas burrito large but didnt seem heavy. Chorizo taco platter and a shrimp quesadilla. Complimentary salsa verde was nice. I was disappointed in the guac. Nothing really interesting and had several chunks that were like a quarter avocado.  I think my desired stars is a 3.5. 3 seems low, 4 seems high. Other nag is that the bartenders werent engaging at all. Part of the fun of sitting at the bar is a rapport w/ the bartenders and there was none. Would def go back but wouldn't crave doing so.
.
Best Chinese food in Reno/ sparks. Combo meals are a great value. Love this place. Thank you for the quality!!!!

I am a very regular customer, but that will most likely be coming to an end. I use the rapid pick up multiple times a week. I've gone through the drive thru numerous times as well. At this location in particular, my order is almost always wrong, so I have to double check and wait to get someone to fix it. Not to mention the staff never been too friendly. But this evening pushed me over the edge. They don't close until 9:30, I put an order in and would be picking it up at 8:40. The app didn't say it was unavailable, as it usually does if they are closed. I placed my order and arrived, all the doors were shut, no biggie went through the drive thru told them my situation, a guy over the speaker told me to pull up to the window and they had it. When I got to the window, the lady stuck her arm out with my bag, I said "oh thank you so much" she didn't say a single word, gave me a dirty look, and slammed the window. I'm just over being treated badly at this location. It's ridiculous, I'll drive out of my way to go to another location where people will treat you nicely.

I ordered the Impossible Burger (in-n-out style they currently have) with the vegan cheese. I opted to keep the sauce on as well - very similar to the actual, true in-n-out burgers! 
It was cooked perfect, melted cheese on top, as well as the lettuce, tomato, onion, & sauce combo that keeps it all simple.
As we are still in the 'to-go/delivery' type of world, I picked up my order, which was quick & efficient. This place looks like it'd be a lot of fun, with a fairly decent size lawn and some lawn games and tables.
The one burger was $10.25 ; so a little pricier than the typical in-n-out (also, non-vegan burgers were still about $9.25) - before adding any fries or soda, if that's how you roll!

As a New Yorker I have been eating and loving Nu Yalk Pizza for many years. 
I would order 8 pizzas for my birthday every year.
Nu Yalk Pizza was one of the reasons I could move here.

Something changed when when the original owner retired and left the business to his son.
The pizza is no longer a New York Pizza. 
I asked the pizza maker what happened to the old way the pizza used to be made and said this was how was told to make the pizza.

It is completely flat and generally burnt.

What a disappointment

Finally made it to Bordeaux for our Anniversary! 
It was very crowded inside so we opted to sit outside . It was a bit cold outside but they turned on the heater which was nice. We were greeted promptly. We actually had a nice conversation with the hostess ( she may be the owner) . She congratulated us on our anniversary and suggested we order champagne and said that she would notify the kitchen that it was our anniversary. Maybe they were gonna send a cute dessert out for us but we didn't see anything come out other than our ordered food. The food was just ok , not bad but not the best for the price in my opinion. We both agreed that it was pretty pricey but it's not a problem if it tastes fantastic. So I was a bit disappointed  since we chose it for our celebration. Our  server was very helpful and attentive.

Visited here for the first time during Burger Week and loved their offering with bacon jam.  Not an area of town I visit a lot currently, but good to know it's around for when the new soccer stadium is built; this could be a great pregame stop.
This is my favorite Italian restaurant in town. Their food is always super delicious. They're service is always great and the restaurant itself is very cozy and inviting.

So being a California girl we were so nervous to find a place with good Mexican food. Welp we found it! Being vegan there are several things you can tweak to make this place a hit. I went for the large tortilla plain bean burrito, topped with a red sauce. 

Not only am I still full but, it was as authentic to Cali as I have found yet. No tex-mex here. 

The margaritas are amazing, being that I can't consume sweet and sour they made a skinny margarita that was delightful. Fresh fruit inside.... (which I will say hold off on next time because the seeds) but, still top notch.

We will return with the kiddos next time! 

Thanks Iguana's for taking us back to Cali for a delicious lunch!

Went to Cubby Cattle for my sisters early birthday dinner. Everything was delicious as usual. The oxtail tomato broth is sooo good. Cindy our server was very attentive and took such good care of us. Chubby Cattle is one of my favorite hot pot places in the city.....

This restaurant was beautiful on the inside. With all things considered with Covid-19, tables were spaced out which resulted in a 35 minute wait, without reservation. So not too bad. The wine wall is tall and eye catching, the food follows up with a great taste and vibe.

BEST GLUTEN FREE PIZZA EVER. The staff was unbelievably kind. My fiancé and I split a large pizza which left us both with 4 normal sized slices. Pizzas include 5 toppings with no hidden charges which was ahhhmazing.

Warning, the free drink or salad with a check in is only for take out orders, so we didn't qualify. Wish that there was a way to specify that on the app.

But guys, seriously, go here. My friend got a non-GF pizza too and said it was incredible.
This was such an incredible discovery. They have the best smoothies and the healthy alternative to chicken strips. Can't beat that!

This is our favorite breakfast place in the upper northwest side of town. It's in the same location as Trader Joe's and Starbucks. On this day I ordered an oatmeal with  freshly sliced banana and strawberries. It was delicious! My favorite part of the menu is their Juice Bar. They offer a small selection of freshly made juice concoctions. My favorite is the "Morning Meditation ".

I go every morning to grab a coffee here! Usually a snack too. So great for meeting up with friends or bringing your laptop to get some work done. Food is always fresh and delicious! I love this neighborhood spot! Best treats too
Very good place to go for a "healthy" fresh meal.  Kung pao cauliflower is amazing. Although food is very good a little on the expensive size and small portions.

Tattooed Mom is not like any bar/ restaurant that I have ever been in. 

Located on busy South Street in a shopping area, parking is a challenge! I had to circle the area a few times before finding metered parking. 

Once we found the place, the guy at the door carded my daughter. As I sat there and saw other patrons enter, he carded (i believe) anybody that looked under 30 years old.

Like i said......I've never seen any place like Tattooed Mom! Everywhere you look, there is something to see. All kinds of crazy decor all around even on the ceiling. 
I would describe it as a Punk Rock aesthetic.  Also very collectic with the seating.  Mismatched tables and chairs and even a couch and coffee tables to eat at. Even though I was clearly out of my element everyone was so nice. Waiter, very pleasant!
Bartender equally as nice!

Now......for the food, me and my daughter have completely different eating challenges,  but what brings us together is places like Tattooed Mom. They have a great variety of Vegan and Non-Vegan options which is hard to find at most restaurants.
I decided to be nice and get a Vegan option so we could share. I got a Chubbsteak wrap and BBQ Tater Tots, my daughter got a Pickled Fried Chicken Sandwich and Cheesy Tots.
I was surprised that everything was fresh and really good!  The portions are a good size and I was satisfied with my meal.
We didn't get anything from the bar, so can't speak of the drinks.
So sorry we didn't go upstairs,  but hear it's even more

oh how I wish I was back in New Orleans eating crawfish, listening to jazz music and enjoying some really great plates at Royal House. Order the oysters! Im writing this review two years later and yet i still think about the grilled oysters here. They were heaven and i cant wait to go back and eat another 2 dozen. Great service and delicious food!
Great job Full Belly Deli. Kick ass wrap today(Thai chicken) and cowboy chili. I'll be back

After reading some of the other reviews, I was a little worried coming here for bottomless brunch. There were a lot of comments about how slow the service could be.... but my experience was completely different.

We had a party of 15 and all of us did bottomless mimosas. The service was very quick with the mimosas and they replaced everyone's drinks at different times so quickly! Angelo was our waiter and he was THE BEST! Gave great recommendations on drinks (I got a persuasion - so delicious and highly recommend). 

Food was great, my boyfriend ordered steak & eggs and I had the salmon and waffles. Both were great choices! I was so surprised by the waffle salmon combo but it was similar to locs bagel with cream cheese, great twist on it and SO delicious.

Ambience is great, definitely a step up from your standard breakfast place. A great place for a date or even gathering with family.

Great fried chicken place! I got the mile chicken with the Mac n cheese and collard greens as sides. The Mac n cheese side was so good and the collard greens were a good mix with all of the comfort food here. The chicken was great as well and pretty hot even though it just had mild sauce. The line was super long and hard to convince everyone to wait but it was worth the wait in the end!

Margaritas were great! This restaurant is definitely not attempting to be authentic Mexican--it is a very loose fusion and very beachy so keep this in mind. Ordered the chipotle shrimp bowl which at first appeared kind of small but it was sooo filling and delicious. Looking forward to having this in the neighborhood!

This place was a very cool place with many options. Vegetarian friendly and had one of the best milkshake options I've tasted so far. The burger itself is amazing and you also have the option to build your own burger as well. The only thing is the burger does not come with fries and it's a little too pricey. Other than that, it's a really mellow place.

My husband and I spotted this place driving down Moana and decided to check it out during one of our weekly Friday lunch dates.

It's super cute inside, bright red walls, cute SODA locker, a picture of much of the food kinda like Scoopers and a huge mural of Coney Island in the back. There is plenty of seating and we snagged a spot off Moana so we could watch the traffic.

This is one of those menus where nothing comes with fries. You have to order them separately and the burgers average $6.99 while dogs are more around $4.99. But this is becoming more commonplace so I'm used to it. I ordered the Guacamole burger, my husband got the Capone dog and we split Mob fries. 

I'm not sure I can say much either way about the food. It wasn't bad. But it wasn't great. It was pretty much just plain food. I think Beefys makes a better burger and Bam Dog makes a better dog. That being said, it's still better than other places I've tried.

Staff was nice. I hate the cheap napkins. We had to use about twenty of them.  I know the place is new so I'm hoping they take suggestions or thoughts and the place will get better and better as the months go by.

If your a Yelper or just dig trying new places I would give it a shot and let us know what you think!

District is always a good idea. Their donuts are really good. If you go in there expecting Krispy Kreme, you might be disappointed. I would say the donuts are more rich than sweet, but oh so good. The sliders and fries are always delicious. Those are more than I would want to pay for something of that size, but you are definitely paying for quality. They also have chocolate milk on tap. That's hard to beat.

This is a really great bbq spot in St Pete. I was immediately greeted when I entered and was seated very quickly. Our server was attentive and helped us with any questions we had on the menu. Really, I thought everyone was friendly with the occasional stop by to ask us how our food was and if they were any issues.

I got the brisket with macaroni and cheese and fries. I loved how tender and juicy the brisket was 10/10 would recommend. That was probably my favorite thing that I had tried that day and I also really loved their homemade barbecue sauces.

Parking can be tricky by the restaurant but there is a paid parking lot right next-door. Will definitely be back when I'm in St Pete to try more on the menu!

Second time in New Orleans and i had to stop here, i had this restaurant bookmarked since 2017! I got their famous shrimp and grits, and the breakfast croissant sandwich. Also tried my friends veggie burger. WELL, the food was GREAT ! When you come to New Orleans, you have to throw the concept of eating healthy out the window because everything in the city is fried and breaded lol! BUT this cute little café offers great vegan options, and healthy alternatives. The shrimp and grits were Devine, the best plate i had in the whole trip. Truly spectacular, and if you do not get this dish you will leave NOLA disappointed. The sandwich was also very good and so was the veggie burger- nice texture and didnt fall apart. Now the ambience here is fantastic. We had 70s weather therefore we opted to sit outside, the Mardi Gras décor was picture perfect  !!! A must try.

If I could give the restaurant zero stars I would the service is very horrible they don't even organize the lines of people waiting and reservations everyone is just scattered outside and not only that but they prioritize who to let in first and once I got to my table to top it off I ask the waitress that I was celebrating my anniversary and I came from far and the only reason I reserved the restaurant was because of the fire table and she literally didn't accommodate me worst customer service ever she even told me if I want to leave I could what a racist restaurant would never ever recommend this place to anyone unfortunately I didn't get the waitress name!! So angry if they have a party of three on a table I don't know why she couldn't accommodate us!!! Just horrible!! They shouldn't hire people like her!
Best espresso since Italy, bar none. A must go. Can be overwhelming on the weekends.  Find a seat at the pastry espresso area and Tuck in.

Visited Sandler's last Wednesday for a work lunch. We tried the bacon on a stick and the Philly cheesesteak scotch egg. Both were incredible. I had never had a scotch egg before and the cheesesteak twist was delicious! The bacon was thick cut with a spicy maple dipping sauce. Delicious and great presentation. For my entree I ordered the Cobb. This thing is MASSIVE. The bowl was so big I almost needed to stand up to eat it. I would definitely go back and try some of the additional seafood options

I had the chicken steak seafood fried rice. It was amazing. Portion was gigantic. I'm a big eater and got three meals out of it. Ended up throwing the rest out just cause I'm bougie and didn't want to eat it a 4th time
Absolutely the BEST donut shop you'll ever come across...ANYWHERE! Their apple fritters and cheese pockets are to die for.

Just spent $83.73 and threw it all in the trash. Way to greasy, cheap meat used, just terrible. This place use to be good but this was just unacceptable quality. p.a- $2 delivery charge on that size order, really? Never again, beware guys!

Our server Elijah was amazing! I highly recommend the Funky Feta burger. It is delicious and taste better than so many regular burgers. Also, try the flat bread tacos. I'm not vegan but I love this place and will be back so many times. Good food, good service, good vibes!!! Try this place!

I've been wanting to come for so many years. Wow was I missing out. I loved everything I order to eat was perfect and the bar was set high. Service was the best I've ever experienced. Every one was friendly and I just loved the place .

Great service and food! Funnel fries are amazing. Imagine funnel cake but sliced as fries so each piece is perfectly fried and cooked through. Kentucky colonel is excellent. 3 large pieces of fried chicken over mashed potatoes with gravy, bacon, corn and cheese. 
Kids meals come with cookies :)
Can't wait to return and work through the rest of the menu.

I tried this place out recently. The GOOD stuff: the butter chicken curry was pretty good, and they include a proper, large amount of decent basmati rice. The BAD stuff: I was forced by DoorDash to order naan--it was quite small and partly burnt. The chicken in the butter chicken was minimal, fatty, and contained gristle. Half of the chicken, I had to spit out due to being unedible. Very disappointed.

If you're craving good pad Thai, this is the place to be! We went on a Friday night and it was packed! They seem to do really well with carry out so if you are not comfortable eating inside, place a carry out order! It's very spaced out inside and some tables are closed to allow for social distancing.  

The food was amazing! So much flavor and came out super hot. Since it was so busy with carry out, the service wasn't great but I understand the struggle to keep up with everything. Can't wait to go back and try more! Especially their dumplings because they look amazing!

Oh my God. I was told that this was going to be good, but wow! The wife and I visiting from Chicago popped in and had a great lunch before the Music City Bowl. I haf a brisket sandwich with fries and she had the brosket tacos with mac and cheese and brocolli salad. The brisket was THE MOST TENDER brisket I've ever tasted. The sauces were excellent. The mac and cheese was great. The fries were perfect. Price with drinks was $33.01, not unaffordable. We will definitely be back again!

The place is very dishonest. I placed a order, payed most in cash and the rest in debit... after waiting almost a hour and NEVER got my food. I decided to ask for my money back. They claimed I never gave them cash & since they dont give receipts there they wouldnt know.  I never recieved my food or my money back . Worst experience ever.  I got robbed by this place.

First time at Bone Fish since moving to the area and prior we ate at Bonefish in Secaucus NJ and ever trip was near perfect.  My only complaint about the restaurants in the area really falls upon the customers-- a desire for food to be smothered in cheese or sauces.  Glad that Bonefish has designed a fish menu in which you can choose your topping... but what about nothing or near nothing or much lighter.

We were taken to our table upon arrival, thank you for accommodating us as we were greatly late.  We were met with a server and a new trainee-- good luck everyone starts with a day 1.

We ordered our beverages- my wife a glass of Chardonnay and a Moscow Mule for me.  We started with an app order of the beef & ginger dumplings which had a really nice flavor; however, it should have been noted on the menu that they use full strength soy sauce, not lite. Plus we later learned when we inquired that the ingredients to the sauce are pickled and add more salt... not exactly an American Heart Association approved dish if you are watching your salt intake.  Tasty nonetheless.

My wife enjoyed her lobster reef order of a single tale with spinach and we devoured my trout dish- parm crusted which was sauteed.  My only complaint was that I didn't want a starch and was willing to forgo 2 sides for 1 better side, being the asparagus.  But was told there'd be a surcharge. I was giving up 2 for 1.  I guess servers who are the face of the restaurant at Bone Fish like other chains are held to

I like brisket, tender and juicy with all the fixings. If you like brisket stop by this location and be prepared for a good meal. This Marana gem is the only location in the Tucson area and deserves your business.

The renovated decor is nice, and the place seems clean. The food is basic average diner quality, which is fine, but the prices are a little too high for diner food in Pottstown. Most of their local diner-style competitors beat their prices. Don't get any kind of "ethnic" (i.e., non-American/English style) food, though, because they just don't do most of that stuff well. Stick to the "basic" stuff and you'll be ok.

On the outside this place looks perfect, then you come in and realize that it is. The music on the patio is great, the linguini is absolutely amazing. The service is so so great. Will come again the next time I'm in Nashville!

I'm so sad that this Pho Hoa closed during COVID. Another pho restaurant opened at it's location. I haven't been yet but my Aunt says it's not the same. I really miss the Banh Mi and Pho combo. This combo is impossible to find at other pho restaurants.

First time. I came here after a co-worker recommended this place. We are looking for some fresh catch fish which is wishful thinking but we definitely found head of salmon for our Sinigang (sour soap). We also bought balot (Filipino Delicacy). This place also require for customer to wear a mask and to practice social distancing.
Amazing food combinations that is more like art work but tastes as good as it looks. Lots of attention to detail. Definitely coming back again and again

How is it that I feel sick every single time I eat here? Unfortunately it's never my choice but friends will wanna go and I swear last night is the last time I set foot here. 
I gave it 2 stars instead of one because the service is totally acceptable and the food doesn't even taste bad but I've gone here 4 times in my life and every single time I've felt nauseous and sick after. I don't think it's just this specific location and I'm pretty sure it has to do with the quality of the food BJ's in general has, but let me tell you this doesn't happen to me in any other restaurant.

Very friendly staff! The juice bar is a little expensive but the food is reasonably priced and very good. Lots of shaded, outdoor seating. Close proximity to an ice cream/cookie dough place. The area is popular but it's in a nice, quiet part of town. Great food and nice staff! Would come back here.

I've left reviews before but they are gone from yelp so I'll try it again. I've gone here for years and love the food. It's usually not busy. The staff are excellent and the food selection is great. Food tastes great. The food is high quality. They've got some Chinese and Thai food. This is not the average Asian place, this is higher quality. I like many dishes on the menu. Pad Thai is always good. So is pineapple chicken. The chicken fried rice is very good. This is all better than any tiny takeout joint in the shopping center. I think some people might be fooled by the small size and outside look of the place but it is awesome. Its nice looking but small and not extra fancy. It's like a well run PF Chang's but without the giant fancy building. We will continue to make the long drive and come back here.
Great food, friendly and attentive staff, and cozy atmosphere both inside and outside by the patio.

It has been a few years since this CFA has been opened. My main complaint in the past was that the drive-through and customer service was hit or miss. After the few years, this location has definitely worked its kinks out.

I'm not sure if it was the pandemic, the more years of experience, or maybe both, but the drive-through is spot on now. There are employees that will take your orders at the drive-through, and the speed at which I receive my food has greatly increased. This location has event built a one of those covers for the employees to keep them cool or warm depending on the weather!

The customer service has also been great! All the employees seem to be cheerful and pleasant to talk to even on these colder days. I also can't remember when the last time my order was fulfilled incorrectly, I know this was previously an issue.

This location has stepped up their game, so I'm updating my review to 5 stars! Nice work!
